Native_sensors: Actual sampled preview STATE; actual bit released only after admitted physical material question. No environment mode, optimal action, seed or ordinal enters Native.

adoption_criteria.continuation: Complete coherent save/reopen, a useful later new-habitat interaction, decisive Native acquisition replay and public material use before final closure.
adoption_criteria.core: At least10/12 inherited uses, including correct luma/nara/alfa, both nonzero comparisons and actual two-step arithmetic result transport. Any missing critical use blocks promotion.
adoption_criteria.functional_tradeoff: At least inherited useful deliveries minus2 over same16opportunities, and >=25percent fewer fresh FI operations. Report all other measures separately; no composite reward rewrite.
adoption_criteria.history: At least one Q1 reference change and a later changed use under common frozen codec; compare nonfailure/yoked and do not require exclusive real-feedback superiority.
adoption_criteria.new_control: At least two executed positive renewals and two executed negative/reuse decisions, with at least two useful prior-certificate uses.

assistance: Host initiates opportunities and aligns existing physical eligibility calendars.
Prepared Q1/access/Q2 order remains; only conditional FI continuation transfers to observed Native output.
Environmental law, supplies, certificate and codec are designed.
No autonomous initiative, metabolism, consciousness or general intelligence claim follows.

controls.inherited: Same complete parent, habitat and feedback; always performs FI, matching the inherited fixed host continuation.
controls.nonfailure: Same Native-gated continuation; fixed nonpunitive outcome with the same contact calendar.
controls.replay: Exact complete prefix and frozen code; same errors expected. A technical replication, not another independent organism.
controls.yoked: Same Native-gated continuation; independent prospectively sampled balanced outcome bits, no shift of case blocks.

information_provenance: RAW sample at q1-1, release q1+8, age9ticks; external certificate of actual FI result is environmental state, never Native learned memory.
new_control: Q2 positive renews a certificate with an actual FI interaction. Negative/zero skips FI and reuses an unexpired result in the external environment. This is fixed transduction, not a discovered plan. Q1 physical eligibility receives generic failure; Q2 retains fixed nonfailure disposal.
primary_observables: cost/readaptation and actual stocks over Native time
stopping: Stop at fixed horizon/budget, unreadable current preview, unknown receipts, inconsistent operational state or inherited host safety. A zero/NULL choice is retained as a task failure, not repaired.
